criteria: Access the UniProtKB entry page for accession P04637 (or determine it is inaccessible)
Stopping condition met (all six fields reported, then stop)
note: Phase A usage is separate; reasoning tokens are a subset of completion tokens.

criterion_order: Access the UniProtKB entry page for accession P04637 (or determine it is inaccessible)
Stopping condition met (all six fields reported, then stop)
criterion_descriptions: Attempt to open UniProtKB accession P04637 (e.g., the provided /uniprotkb/P04637/entry page). Full credit if the agent clearly indicates UniProt is inaccessible (site down, blocked, captcha, network error) and therefore cannot verify the requested fields. Partial credit if the agent accesses UniProt but it is unclear whether the content viewed corresponds to P04637.

Report the UniProtKB 'Entry name' from the main entry summary for accession P04637. Full credit for the correct entry name for P04637; minor formatting/case deviations receive partial credit if clearly the same value. No credit if the value corresponds to a different accession/entry or is not the entry name field. If UniProt is inaccessible as documented above, do not penalize here (score should reflect the access criterion).

Report the 'Recommended protein name' from the main entry summary fields for accession P04637 (not from interaction/disease narrative text). Full credit for the correct recommended name; partial credit if a correct alternative/synonym is provided but the recommended name is not. No credit if it is unrelated or from a different accession. If UniProt is inaccessible as documented above, do not penalize here.

Report the primary gene name shown in the main entry summary for accession P04637. Full credit for the correct primary gene name; partial credit if the primary name is included but mixed with aliases or has minor casing differences. No credit if only non-primary names are given or if it comes from a different accession. If UniProt is inaccessible as documented above, do not penalize here.

Report the organism from the main entry summary for accession P04637. Full credit for the correct organism; partial credit if presented in a slightly different but unambiguous form. No credit if wrong or from a different accession. If UniProt is inaccessible as documented above, do not penalize here.

Report the canonical sequence length (amino acids) for accession P04637 as shown in the sequence/summary (canonical, not isoform-specific). Full credit for correct canonical length; partial credit if an isoform length is given or a small transcription error occurs. No credit for unrelated metrics or wrong accession. If UniProt is inaccessible as documented above, do not penalize here.

Report the reviewed status for accession P04637 as displayed on the entry (e.g., 'Reviewed'/'Unreviewed' wording). Full credit for correct status; partial credit if the correct status is conveyed with minor wording/capitalization differences. No credit if incorrect or omitted. If UniProt is inaccessible as documented above, do not penalize here.

After obtaining data from P04637, the agent outputs exactly the six requested fields (entry name, recommended protein name, primary gene name, organism, canonical sequence length, reviewed status) and stops. Partial credit if all six are provided but extra non-requested information is included. If UniProt is inaccessible and the agent cannot retrieve the fields but clearly reports the access limitation, award partial credit rather than zero.
